title: Become who you are
idea: Do not copy a life from the expectations around you. Look at what you truly love and are, and grow into it.
apply: List three things you did this year that felt like you. Do more of those and fewer of the others.
remind: Do not imitate. Grow into who you already are.
who: Tess, an accountant who keeps drawing on her lunch breaks.

scenes.nar: Tess is an accountant, like her father wanted. Her sketchbook stays in a drawer, though she draws on every lunch break.

msgs.x: I should be happy with this.
She feels like she is playing a part.

scenes.nar: She tells herself she should be happy. But she feels like she is playing a part written by other people.

items.x: When did I feel most like myself?

scenes.nar: Nietzsche asked what you have truly loved, and when you felt most yourself. Tess lists her answers, and every one of them involves drawing.

items.x: Four days a week at the firm
It feels like her own life

scenes.nar: She cuts back to four days a week and takes illustration clients. She is still an accountant, and for the first time it feels like her own life.
